svg.desc: Median warm HTTP throughput in requests per second. Scrapanium Bend versus matched curl_cffi, both using curl-impersonate 2.2.3 and Chrome 146. HTTP/1.1, Small response: 3,636 versus 2,042, 1.78 times; HTTP/1.1, 64 KiB response: 2,525 versus 1,893, 1.33 times; HTTPS/1.1, Small response: 2,551 versus 1,942, 1.31 times; HTTPS/2, Small response: 1,972 versus 1,510, 1.31 times; HTTP/1.1 · batch of 16, 10 ms server delay: 1,438 versus 1,308, 1.10 times; HTTPS/2 · batch of 16, Small responses: 6,452 versus 4,996, 1.29 times. Five shuffled runs on Linux/WSL2, i5-13420H. Local loopback only. Source: benchmarks/results/local.json.
